verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents tax-compliant invoices, credit notes, customizable payment receipts, custom fields, and invoices sent automatically on a scheduled date or on a recurring basis. Sequential numbering and memos are not evidenced, and automatic delivery is shown only for invoices, not for credit notes or receipts. Missing for 10: sequential/gapless numbering, memo/notes fields, automatic delivery of credit notes and receipts, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Create a credit note and apply it to an invoice.
Enhance the look and feel of your payment receipts with customizable templates.
Create custom fields to capture more details.
Zoho Invoice lets you schedule your invoices to be automatically sent to your customers on the date you choose.
